import numpy as np
import itertools

def task_func(matrix):
    arr = np.asarray(matrix)
    sorted_arr = np.sort(arr, axis=None)
    unique_pairs = list(dict.fromkeys(itertools.combinations(sorted_arr.tolist(), 2)))
    return sorted_arr, unique_pairs
